source.oemTestTitle: High temperature alarm in freezing chamber

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. Restore power only for live diagnostics when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Mandatory diagnostic mode available (§10.5). Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After mandatory mode entry, proceed with OEM fault-code maintenance steps.

steps.title: Door sealed and power stable
steps.body: Verify freezer door is tight shut and unit was not left off for extended period.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify freezer door is tight shut and unit was not left off for extended period.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Correct door seal or restore power before sensor path.

steps.title: Compressor refrigerating
steps.body: Is compressor running and cabinet cooling normally?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is compressor running and cabinet cooling normally?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Compressor not running — check VFD inverter LED fault codes.

steps.title: Follow E2 sensor path
steps.body: When door and compressor OK, follow E2 freezer temperature sensor maintenance (harness + B3839 bench ohms).
steps.sourceExcerpt: When door and compressor OK, follow E2 freezer temperature sensor maintenance (harness + B3839 bench ohms).

steps.title: Check VFD inverter board
steps.body: Inspect variable-frequency driver LED blink pattern per §11.2 (overcurrent, overvoltage, undervoltage, LOCK, overload).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect variable-frequency driver LED blink pattern per §11.2 (overcurrent, overvoltage, undervoltage, LOCK, overload).

steps.title: Correct door/power
steps.oemOutcome: Reseal door or restore power; allow 24 hr stabilization.

steps.title: Service VFD/compressor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace VFD board or compressor per §11.2 LED fault pattern.

steps.title: E9 path complete
steps.oemOutcome: E9 high-temp alarm addressed via door/compressor/sensor checks.
